chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, looked upon the people of the Earth with a look and chose me. Then He looked again and chose you after me, and made you the one in charge of the affairs of my nation after me. And there is no one after us like us.

key_terms.الْقَيِّمَ: The one in charge / The sustainer of affairs
key_terms.اِطِّلاعَةً: A look / A glance of selection

ai.seo_question: Who did the Prophet choose as his successor to manage the affairs of the nation?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the divine selection (*I'tilā'*) of the Prophet and Ali, establishing Ali as the *Qayyim* who sustains the community's affairs post-Prophet. It underscores the unique, unrivaled status of the Ahl al-Bayt, a core tenet in Shia theology regarding their infallible authority and leadership.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-300 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said,

“Indeed the Honorable the Exalted God looked upon the people of the Earth once and chose me. Then He took another look and chose you (Ali). He established you in charge of the affairs of my nation after me. There will be no one like us after us.”
